messages:
anna-partners: Quick sync — ISV/tooling push for marketplace + HW partner validation + SI enablement. Goal: soft-launch with 3 ISVs + 2 HW OEMs in ~6 weeks. Need marketplace listing checklist, SDK adapter, perf smoke harness, and co-marketing assets. Who can take which piece?

mike-platform: Timeline seems doable but we need a marketplace metadata template and legal checklist (contracts + co-marketing). I can own that.

sara-devex: I can own docs + quickstart + minimal eval set. Can we define a compact 'compat contract' (API surface + expected behavior) to hand to ISVs?

jonas-sdks: I'll draft an SDK adapter template and a LangChain example flow. Quick question: are we prioritizing LangChain + LlamaIndex first, or do we scope to multiple orchestrators?

kyle-eng: Prioritize LangChain + LlamaIndex for MVP. Engineering ask: we need a runtime test harness for latency/cost (10k invocations across typical sequences) to publish numbers for the marketplace card. Also we hit a failing hw-adapter smoke yesterday.

integrations-bot: FYI: last smoke run for hw-nv-atlas adapter returned 2 failing tests (quant path mismatch).

anna-partners: Thanks — @kyle-eng what’s the failure surface: quantization mismatch vs API mismatch? Also suggest we include a fallback plan if firmware/driver fix is delayed.

kyle-eng: Root cause: quantization profile mismatch on int8 path for 2 of 3 model configs. Looks like vendor driver differences + older firmware. Short-term: we can ship with an FP16/soft-fallback for those models. Long-term: vendor firmware bump + new quant profile.

mike-platform: For marketplace listing, I'm proposing these metadata fields: connector_name, short_description, supported_models, supported_quant_profiles, required_firmware_min, regions, sla_tier, pricing_link, demo_link, integration_docs_link, legal_contact. I'll assemble a JSON template we can reuse.

sara-devex: I'll create the quickstart and an eval harness: a small prompt set + expected output snippets so we can detect regressions during rollout. Will also create a 'how we measure quality' blurb for the marketplace card.

jonas-sdks: Draft SDK snippet (will publish in adapter template repo):

```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient()
# adapter shim for gateway/orchestrator
resp = client.generate(model='llama-3-mix', input='Hello world')
print(resp.text)
```

I'll add a LangChain integration example (runner + memory + retry logic). Branch: isv-marketplace/langchain-adapter.

anna-partners: Announcement cadence idea: embargoed partner demo during press week of May 10. Need final tech and assets by May 1 to be safe. Is that realistic?

kyle-eng: If vendor firmware drops this week and we run perf tests in the next 2 weeks, yes. Otherwise fallback timeline slips. I'll try to get firmware contact engaged today.

mike-platform: Legal confirmed a May 3 contract cutoff for co-marketing approvals. Finance needs pricing draft by Apr 28 to model revenue split.

sara-devex: Docs freeze target Apr 30. I'll schedule the docs PR and coordinate with marketing for the blurb.

anna-partners: Action items (quick):
- Mike -> marketplace metadata template + contract checklist (due Apr 28)
- Jonas -> SDK adapter PR + LangChain example (due Apr 25)
- Kyle -> perf harness + HW QA + fallback plan (due Apr 22)
- Sara -> quickstart + eval set + docs freeze (due Apr 30)
I'll coordinate partner comms and PR reviews. Tagging @integrations-bot for follow-ups. :raised_hands:

integrations-bot: Noted. Creating weekly reminders for this thread: every Mon 10:00 PT. First reminder scheduled at 1723460000.

jonas-sdks: :thumbsup: starting the branch now. Will include a small CI job that runs the eval harness against a lightweight mock of the gateway.

mike-platform: One decision point: Redwood-owned marketplace listing vs partner-owned listing. Recommend Redwood-owned for discoverability; partners sign an MOU and we host the listing assets. Thoughts?

sara-devex: Agreed — easier UX if we control the listing. Also want to include an explicit 'quality gates' section in the listing (perf thresholds, regression alert hooks).

anna-partners: Good. Risk note: if vendor firmware >2w, fallback is to ship with the software fallback (slower, higher cost) and call out supported_quant_profiles accordingly. Keep me posted.

kyle-eng: Acknowledged. I'll add a runtime flag `--force-fp16-fallback` and test it across our perf harness.

mike-platform: Also looping in marketing/legal separately for the co-marketing blurb and the demo embargo.

anna-partners: Thanks all — I'll run weekly syncs and close action items. Ping me in-thread for any blockers.

integrations-bot: Closing note: creating ticket tracker and checklist board under Partnerships -> ISV-Marketplace (will post link shortly).
